source: L1 is the first hardware-managed cache encountered by many ordinary memory paths near an ZXNAME0000XZ. Its exact organization changes across architectures, and different memory spaces can interact with it differently. Nsight Compute therefore presents L1/TEX as an architectural unit rather than pretending there is one universal textbook cache design.[3]
zh: L1 是 ZXNAME0000XZ 附近许多普通内存路径遇到的第一个硬件管理缓存。它的确切组织随着体系结构的不同而变化，不同的内存空间可以以不同的方式与之交互。因此，Nsight Compute 将 L1/TEX 作为一个架构单元，而不是假装存在一种通用的教科书缓存设计。 [3]
